name: verdandi

scripts.build:claude: npm run build -w @verdandi/claude-runtime && npm run build -w @verdandi/claude-sidecar
scripts.typecheck:claude: npm run build -w @verdandi/claude-runtime && npm run typecheck -w @verdandi/claude-runtime && npm run typecheck -w @verdandi/claude-sidecar

//test: Each script builds BOTH packages before running EITHER suite: the sidecar consumes the runtime package's dist, never its src, and tsc emits JavaScript even when it reports errors -- so run the root script, not one workspace's, before believing a result.
